trap-nonspeakable.notes: MATH FINDINGS (report, not fixed), three items. (1) THE SUPPRESSION MECHANISM IS STATED BACKWARDS, TWICE. The block defines ||delta_k||_F = sqrt(|delta_k . G . delta_k|) = sqrt(|sum_alpha lambda_alpha c_{k alpha}^2|), an ABSOLUTE value over an indefinite form. It then says interior neutrons have delta_k 'dominated by the negative eigenspace', and that 'This suppresses their Frobenius norm'. Domination by the negative eigenspace makes the signed sum large in MAGNITUDE, so the absolute value - and hence the norm - is LARGE, not suppressed. Conversely 'Boundary neutrons have more balanced projections, yielding larger ||delta_k||_F': balanced positive and negative projections CANCEL in the signed sum, giving a SMALLER absolute value. Under the block's own definition both sentences invert the mechanism they assert. The empirical ordering (boundary > interior) may still be right; the explanation offered for it is not. The same inverted mechanism appears in the interpreting sibling rem:gram-weight-eigenstructure. (2) IT IS NOT A NORM. The block calls ||.||_F 'the Frobenius norm induced by the Gram matrix' while stating two sections later that G 'is symmetric but not positive definite'. An indefinite form induces no norm; the absolute value patches positivity but destroys the parallelogram/Cauchy-Schwarz structure and makes ||delta||_F^2 differ from the displayed delta . G . delta whenever that quantity is negative. Rename it (a signed Frobenius pairing, magnitude taken separately) or state the absolute value where the object is introduced. (3) COUNTING AND LABELLING SLIPS. 'The Q-value contains three factors' precedes a list of Delta_k, w_k^G and N, but the displayed equation has four - m_e is in the formula and in the Inputs line, and is omitted from the list. And N is glossed as 'the coherent sum over all conversion channels', which it is not: the sum over channels is sum_k w_k^G Delta_k, and since the weights are normalised to 1 that sum is a weighted AVERAGE; the separate factor N is a multiplicity, so Q = N m_e times the w-average of Delta.
